overview_description.description:
Fundok is a cloud based guest experience management platform that targets the fast growing market of short term rentals. 
Fundok platform enriches travelers experience by providing them with relevant and localized information about their destination as well as access to a suite of services such as food delivery, grocery, bookings and reservations, as well as essential information on their apartment and area.
FunDok platform enables short term rental operators to enhance their guest's experience by building loyalty, diversifying their revenue and differentiating from competitors.
